about:
Assembly Solutions was founded in 2001 by four entrepreneurs in an incubator facility in St. Charles, Missouri. The company now operates from Bridgeton, Missouri, where it has grown into a full-service electronic contract manufacturer.

The company specializes in printed circuit board assemblies using both through-hole and surface-mount technology, custom cable and harness assemblies, and complete electromechanical box builds. It provides turnkey services that span engineering design, materials procurement, manufacturing, testing, and quality assurance, all under one roof. The facility is described as state-of-the-art, though its square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Assembly Solutions serves original equipment manufacturers across agriculture, aviation, construction and mining, general manufacturing, medical devices, LED lighting and chargers, video and surveillance, and industrial controllers. Customers cite long-term partnerships, with one relationship spanning 18 years, and highlight the firm's ability to handle both prototype runs and high-volume production.

The founders started the business after recognizing a growing demand for reliable contract manufacturing in the region. The company emphasizes shorter lead times, cost-effective pricing, seamless communication, scalable production, and end-to-end support. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and builds to J-STD-001, IPC-A-610 Class II and Class III, and UL/CSA/CE standards, with PPAP and FMEA processes available.
